memoryTip: Equity = fairness—equitable means just and even-handed to all sides.
correctPassage: An equitable distribution of resources was the panel’s main goal.
wrongPassages: The judge’s equitable ruling gave every prize to one side without hearing the other.
An equitable split left one partner with nothing and the other with the firm.
The wharf’s equitable crane load chart was for equipment long since scrapped.

definition: not able to be reached or achieved
memoryTip: Can’t attain it—unattainable means out of reach, not merely hard.
correctPassage: Perfection is unattainable, but steady improvement is not.
wrongPassages: The shelf was unattainable once she stepped over and lifted the box down.
Her unattainable goal was finished before lunch on the first quiet day.
The summit felt unattainable after the marked path delivered them to the top.

memoryTip: Vapor-thin flavor—vapid talk is bland, empty, and quickly forgotten.
correctPassage: The speech was elegant in form but vapid in content.
wrongPassages: The vapid lecture packed every theorem with full proofs and sharp examples.
Critics called the novel vapid because every page startled them awake.
A vapid load test hits one request and graphs a single point.

definition: a penalty for disobeying; or official permission
memoryTip: Two-faced word: sanctions punish—or sanction means officially allow.
correctPassage: The league may sanction the team for violating recruitment rules.
wrongPassages: He packed emergency sanction next to flares that had expired years ago.
Without any vote, the clerk claimed to sanction the plan by ignoring it entirely.
Deleting thumbs.db finally made folder sanction truly empty.

definition: the state of being out of place or inconsistent
memoryTip: Incongruous mismatch—incongruity is when pieces simply don’t fit.
correctPassage: There is a striking incongruity between the firm’s green claims and its emissions.
wrongPassages: The museum stored its incongruity in a drawer marked miscellaneous hardware.
She enabled incongruity mode that only dimmed the wallpaper.
The matching set showed perfect incongruity: every piece the same color and size.
